name: OMedia Controls
author: lancefaul
description: Media controls for any MPRIS player: album art, a seek bar, playback controls, playlists you can build and save, synced lyrics, a music library, speed, volume, live streams and video, and Winamp's classic visualisers, styled like Omarchy's own panels, with every setting in the popup.

barWidget.description: Album art and track title in the bar; in the popup, seek, playback, playlists, lyrics, a music library, settings and Winamp-style visualisers.
